literature.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 使用复合参考标准的诊断性能显示 IgM (AUC 0.8150) 和 IgG (AUC 0.7917) 具有中等一致性,而多价形式 (AUC 0.9695) 具有出色的性能,具有最高的灵敏度 (88.6%) 和总体一致性 (84.8%)。 [10.1016/j.jim.2026.114113]
免疫组织化学染色显示红色沉淀,证实组织切片中存在 狂犬病 抗原。 [10.3791/30806]
研究中概述的过程成功地生成了小鼠脑组织中 狂犬病病毒 感染的三维表示,通过概述的步骤展示了感染的进展。 [10.3791/23465]
使用开发的方法,该研究确定了三只小鼠的 1,532 个与初级视觉皮层神经元连接的突触对,证明了该方法的效率和可扩展性。 [10.1016/j.crmeth.2026.101579]
该研究报告了一种用于测量人类 狂犬病 疫苗 糖蛋白的新型 ELISA 的开发,以及对 狂犬病病毒 定量的实时 RT-PCR 测定的验证。它还强调了使用宏基因组测序进行 狂犬病病毒 检测。 [10.1007/s13337-026-00984-8]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Diagnostic performance using a composite reference standard showed moderate agreement for IgM (AUC 0.8150) and IgG (AUC 0.7917), and excellent performance for the polyvalent format (AUC 0.9695), which presented the highest sensitivity (88.6%) and overall agreement (84.8%). [10.1016/j.jim.2026.114113]
Immunohistochemistry staining revealed red precipitates, confirming the presence of rabies antigens in the tissue section. [10.3791/30806]

The process outlined in the study successfully generated a three-dimensional representation of rabies virus infection in mouse brain tissue, demonstrating the progression of the infection through the outlined steps. [10.3791/23465]

Using the developed approach, the study identified 1,532 synaptic pairs connected to neurons in the primary visual cortex across three mice, demonstrating the efficiency and scalability of the method. [10.1016/j.crmeth.2026.101579]

The study reports the development of a novel ELISA for measuring glycoprotein in human rabies vaccines and the validation of a real-time RT-PCR assay for rabies virus quantification. It also highlights the use of metagenomic sequencing for rabies virus detection. [10.1007/s13337-026-00984-8]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
使用复合参考标准的诊断性能显示 IgM (AUC 0.8150) 和 IgG (AUC 0.7917) 具有中等一致性,而多价形式 (AUC 0.9695) 具有出色的性能,具有最高的灵敏度 (88.6%) 和总体一致性 (84.8%)。
免疫组织化学染色显示红色沉淀,证实组织切片中存在 狂犬病 抗原。 [10.3791/30806]。
研究中概述的过程成功地生成了小鼠脑组织中 狂犬病病毒 感染的三维表示,通过概述的步骤展示了感染的进展。 [10.3791/23465]。
使用开发的方法,该研究确定了三只小鼠的 1,532 个与初级视觉皮层神经元连接的突触对,证明了该方法的效率和可扩展性。 [10.1016/j.crmeth.2026.101579]。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.

Diagnostic performance using a composite reference standard showed moderate agreement for IgM (AUC 0.8150) and IgG (AUC 0.7917), and excellent performance for the polyvalent format (AUC 0.9695), which presented the highest sensitivity (88.6%) and overall agreement (84.8%).
Immunohistochemistry staining revealed red precipitates, confirming the presence of rabies antigens in the tissue section. [10.3791/30806].

papers.title: Development and diagnostic evaluation of indirect ELISA for detecting antibodies against the rabies virus glycoprotein in human cerebrospinal fluid
papers.abstract: The accurate detection of intrathecal antibodies against the rabies virus (RABV) is critical for antemortem diagnosis and disease monitoring, particularly when the virus-neutralizing activity is low or delayed. In this study, indirect ELISA assays were developed to detect IgM, IgG, and polyvalent (IgA/IgM/IgG) antibodies against the RABV glycoprotein (RABV G) in cerebrospinal fluid. The RABV G antigen, purified by Lens culinaris lectin affinity chromatography, retained its physicochemical and immunoreactive properties, as confirmed by SDS-PAGE, monoclonal antibody recognition and lectin-binding assays. The analytical validation demonstrated low limits of detection (0.056-0.063), high precision and reproducibility (intra-assay CV ≤ 1.84%), acceptable recovery (101.1-115.6%), linear response (R 2 up to 0.989), and minimal matrix effects. Diagnostic performance using a composite reference standard showed moderate agreement for IgM (AUC 0.8150) and IgG (AUC 0.7917), and excellent performance for the polyvalent format (AUC 0.9695), which presented the highest sensitivity (88.6%) and overall agreement (84.8%). RFFIT analysis of ELISA-positive samples demonstrated neutralizing activity in a subset of IgM-positive cases, and a higher proportion of IgG- and polyvalent-positive samples. All RFFIT-positive samples were positive in the polyvalent ELISA format. Serial CSF sampling from one patient indicated that ELISA-detected binding antibodies preceded measurable neutralizing activity. Overall, indirect ELISA based on the native RABV G provides sensitive detection of intrathecal antibody responses, but it does not consistently predict virus-neutralizing activity. These findings support the complementary use of binding and functional assays with molecular diagnostics for a comprehensive antemortem evaluation of rabies infection in the central nervous system. Future studies in larger cohorts are necessary to define the clinical applicability.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed and evaluated an indirect ELISA for detecting antibodies against the rabies virus glycoprotein in human cerebrospinal fluid. The research aimed to improve antemortem diagnosis, especially when virus-neutralizing activity is low or delayed. The ELISA was validated for its analytical performance, showing low limits of detection, high precision and reproducibility, acceptable recovery, and a linear response. The diagnostic performance demonstrated moderate agreement for IgM and IgG, but excellent agreement for the polyvalent format. RFFIT analysis confirmed neutralizing activity in some ELISA-positive samples, particularly in the polyvalent format. The study highlights the potential of the ELISA as a sensitive tool for detecting intrathecal antibody responses, though it may not consistently predict neutralizing activity. The findings suggest the need for complementary assays in rabies diagnosis. However, the study's limitations include the lack of consistent prediction of neutralizing activity and the need for further validation in larger cohorts.

papers.title_zh: 用于检测人脑脊液中 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白抗体的间接 ELISA 的开发和诊断评估
papers.source_body_en: The accurate detection of intrathecal antibodies against the rabies virus (RABV) is critical for antemortem diagnosis and disease monitoring, particularly when the virus-neutralizing activity is low or delayed. In this study, indirect ELISA assays were developed to detect IgM, IgG, and polyvalent (IgA/IgM/IgG) antibodies against the RABV glycoprotein (RABV G) in cerebrospinal fluid. The RABV G antigen, purified by Lens culinaris lectin affinity chromatography, retained its physicochemical and immunoreactive properties, as confirmed by SDS-PAGE, monoclonal antibody recognition and lectin-binding assays. The analytical validation demonstrated low limits of detection (0.056-0.063), high precision and reproducibility (intra-assay CV ≤ 1.84%), acceptable recovery (101.1-115.6%), linear response (R 2 up to 0.989), and minimal matrix effects. Diagnostic performance using a composite reference standard showed moderate agreement for IgM (AUC 0.8150) and IgG (AUC 0.7917), and excellent performance for the polyvalent format (AUC 0.9695), which presented the highest sensitivity (88.6%) and overall agreement (84.8%). RFFIT analysis of ELISA-positive samples demonstrated neutralizing activity in a subset of IgM-positive cases, and a higher proportion of IgG- and polyvalent-positive samples. All RFFIT-positive samples were positive in the polyvalent ELISA format. Serial CSF sampling from one patient indicated that ELISA-detected binding antibodies preceded measurable neutralizing activity. Overall, indirect ELISA based on the native RABV G provides sensitive detection of intrathecal antibody responses, but it does not consistently predict virus-neutralizing activity. These findings support the complementary use of binding and functional assays with molecular diagnostics for a comprehensive antemortem evaluation of rabies infection in the central nervous system. Future studies in larger cohorts are necessary to define the clinical applicability.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确检测针对 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 的鞘内抗体对于死前 诊断 和疾病监测至关重要,特别是当病毒中和活​​性较低或延迟时。在本研究中,开发了间接 ELISA 测定法来检测脑脊液中针对 RABV 糖蛋白 (RABV G) 的 IgM、IgG 和多价 (IgA/IgM/IgG) 抗体。通过 SDS-PAGE、单克隆抗体识别和凝集素结合测定证实,通过Lens culinaris 凝集素亲和层析纯化的 RABV G 抗原保留了其理化和免疫反应特性。分析验证表明检测限低 (0.056-0.063)、高精度和重现性高(测定内 CV ≤ 1.84%)、可接受的回收率(101.1-115.6%)、线性响应(R 2 高达 0.989)和最小的基质效应。使用复合参考标准的诊断性能显示 IgM (AUC 0.8150) 和 IgG (AUC 0.7917) 具有中等一致性,而多价形式 (AUC 0.9695) 具有出色的性能,具有最高的灵敏度 (88.6%) 和总体一致性 (84.8%)。对 ELISA 阳性样品的 RFFIT 分析表明,部分 IgM 阳性病例以及较高比例的 IgG 和多价阳性样品具有中和活性。所有 RFFIT 阳性样本在多价 ELISA 格式中均呈阳性。一名患者的连续脑脊液取样表明,ELISA 检测到的结合抗体先于可测量的中和活性。总体而言,基于天然 RABV G 的间接 ELISA 提供了鞘内抗体反应的灵敏检测,但它不能一致地预测病毒中和活​​性。这些发现支持结合和功能测定与分子诊断的互补使用,以对中枢神经系统中的 狂犬病 感染进行全面的生前评估。未来需要对更大的 队列研究 进行研究来定义临床适用性。

This video demonstrates the process of preparing and imaging mouse brain tissue infected with the rabies virus (RABV) to evaluate infection progression. It outlines key steps, including tissue staining with fluorescent markers, dehydration, clearing, and mounting for confocal laser scanning microscopy, culminating in the generation of a three-dimensional representation.

papers.title: Wild Felid Attacks on Humans in South and Central America: A 2014-2025 Case Series in French Guiana and Literature Review.
papers.abstract: Wild felids are apex predators that play a crucial role in tropical ecosystems. In South America, interactions between humans and large felids-particularly jaguars ( Panthera onca ) and pumas ( Puma concolor )-are increasingly reported, raising public concern. However, attacks on humans remain poorly documented, and their frequency is likely overestimated. This study assessed the scale of wild felid attacks in French Guiana and South America through a case series and literature review. We conducted a retrospective observational study of all wild felid attacks managed in healthcare facilities in French Guiana between January 2014 and December 2025. Cases were identified through hospital emergency departments, the regional rabies treatment center, and remote clinics. Medical records were reviewed for sociodemographic data, circumstances, clinical outcomes, and management. A systematic literature review (ie, PubMed, ScienceDirect, SciELO, and LILACS) identified documented attacks involving South American wild felids from 1990 to 2025. Reports involving captive animals or lacking methodologic detail were excluded. Four attacks were recorded in French Guiana, with no fatalities, although 1 case led to significant sequelae. The literature review identified 11 events, mainly attributed to jaguars and occasionally pumas. Attacks were rare and often linked to contextual factors such as forest proximity, domestic animals, or impaired animal condition. Severe injuries were reported, including 3 fatal cases. Wild felid attacks on humans remain exceptionally rare in South America and are usually associated with identifiable environmental or anthropogenic factors rather than inherent aggressiveness. Habitat preservation and reduced human-wildlife overlap are key preventive strategies.

papers.title: Rabies surveillance in the United States during 2024
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Describe the epidemiologic landscape of rabies and rabies testing in the US during 2024. Methods Animal rabies testing results from approximately 130 public health, agriculture, and academic laboratories are collected by the US National Rabies Surveillance System (NRSS) each month. Data reported in 2024 were analyzed to examine temporal and geographic trends in animal rabies cases by rabies virus variant (RVV). Results In 2024, 3,834 cases of animal rabies were reported to the NRSS (4.2% of 90,343 samples submitted), representing a 2.0% increase from 2023. Of positive samples, 331 (8.6%) were domestic animals, and 3,503 (91.4%) were wildlife. The most commonly found rabid domestic animal was cats (243 positive [1.3% positivity]), and the most commonly found wildlife were bats (1,376 positive [5.7% positivity]) followed by raccoons (1,080 [10.1% positivity]). Two nonenzootic RVVs gained entry into the US in 2024. Four people died from rabies, including 2 who experienced bat exposures that were left untreated and 1 person whose case involved international travel. Conclusions The expansion of the historical range of enzootic RVVs can lead to substantial public health and animal health burden. Domestically acquired human rabies cases in 2024 underscore the need for continual public education on the risks of rabies exposures to ensure timely and effective administration of postexposure prophylaxis. The internationally acquired human rabies case demonstrates that the US remains vulnerable to human and animal rabies importations. Clinical Relevance The NRSS plays a crucial role in protecting public and animal health by monitoring rabies trends in the US.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在描述 2024 年美国 狂犬病 和 狂犬病 检测的流行病学状况,解决了解 狂犬病 趋势及其影响的科学和公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了来自美国国家 狂犬病 狂犬病 系统 (NRSS) 的数据,该系统每月从大约 130 个公共卫生、农业和学术实验室收集动物 狂犬病 检测结果。2024 年,报告了 3,834 例动物 狂犬病 病例,占提交的 90,343 份样本的 4.2%。
elements_zh.methods: 对 2024 年报告的数据进行了分析,以检查 狂犬病 变体 (RVV) 动物 狂犬病 病例的时间和地理趋势。
elements_zh.main_results: 2024年,向NRSS报告了3,834例动物狂犬病病例(占提交的90,343份样本的4.2%),比2023年增加了2.0%。在阳性样本中,331例(8.6%)是家畜,3,503例(91.4%)是野生动物。最常见的患有狂犬病的家畜是猫(243 例阳性[1.3% 阳性率]),最常见的野生动物是蝙蝠(1,376 例阳性[5.7% 阳性率]),其次是浣熊(1,080 例[10.1% 阳性率])。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 地方性RVV历史范围的扩大可能会导致巨大的公共卫生和动物健康负担。研究结果强调了监测 狂犬病 趋势以应对新出现风险的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 2024 年国内获得的人类 狂犬病 病例强调需要持续进行有关 狂犬病 暴露风险的公众教育,以确保及时有效地实施暴露后预防。国际上获得的人类 狂犬病 病例表明,美国仍然容易受到人类和动物 狂犬病 进口的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告研究设计或数据分析的具体限制。证据强度中等,因为研究结果基于 监测 数据,不包括实验或因果证据。

papers.title: Combined Disruption of Multiple Cytokine Signaling Pathways Enables One-Step Anterograde Tracing with Vesicular Stomatitis Virus.
papers.abstract: Abstract Defining the direct postsynaptic targets of selected neuronal populations remains a major challenge for neural circuit mapping. Vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) spreads efficiently in the anterograde direction, but replication-competent VSV undergoes multistep spread and therefore cannot distinguish direct from indirect downstream targets. Here, we developed a glycoprotein-deleted VSV(VSVdG)-based strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using AAV-mediated trans-complementation with several adaptations. In this system, VSVdG was engineered to encode Cre, allowing a Cre-dependent AAV to express VSV-G only after VSVdG infected the same cells, thereby limiting VSV-G expression to a short time window. To reduce VSV-M-mediated cytotoxicity, we introduced the M33A/M51R double-mutant VSV-Md variant. Using the basal ganglia circuit as a model, we found that efficient one-step VSVdG spread required disruption of cytokine-mediated antiviral responses triggered by AAV transduction and VSV infection. This was achieved by loss of type I interferon signaling in IFNAR1-knockout mice, together with suppression of additional antiviral responses either through AAV-mediated expression of the CVS-N2c rabies virus phosphoprotein or administration of cytokine-blocking antibody cocktail. These adaptations enabled VSVdG spread from dorsal striatum to expected downstream targets in mice of both sexes. However, the downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, revealing an important limitation for interpreting this approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread. Overall, rather than providing a ready-to-use tracing tool, this study presents a VSVdG strategy for one-step anterograde circuit tracing, and defines viral toxicity, innate immunity, and cell-type specificity constraints that must be addressed to develop an efficient and specific monosynaptic anterograde viral tracer. Significance Statement Mapping direct downstream targets of defined neuronal populations is essential for understanding neural circuit function, but reliable monosynaptic anterograde viral tracers remain limited. We developed a VSVdG-based strategy that uses AAV-mediated trans-complementation to restrict VSV-G expression to starter cells in a short time window and incorporates VSV-M variant to reduce toxicity. In the mouse basal ganglia, this system enabled one-step spread from dorsal striatum to expected output regions when innate antiviral barriers were suppressed. Our results identify type I interferon and additional type I/type II interferon-independent cytokine signaling as major restrictions of VSVdG spread. This study establishes proof of principle for VSV-based one-step anterograde tracing while defining viral toxicity, innate immunity, and cell-type specificity constraints in need of further improvement.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a VSVdG-based strategy for one-step anterograde tracing in neural circuits, addressing the challenge of identifying direct postsynaptic targets. The approach involves AAV-mediated trans-complementation to restrict VSV-G expression to starter cells and the use of a VSV-M variant to reduce toxicity. In the mouse basal ganglia, the system enabled one-step spread from dorsal striatum to expected output regions when innate antiviral barriers were suppressed. The authors identified type I interferon and additional cytokine signaling pathways as major restrictions to VSVdG spread. However, the study noted that downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, highlighting a limitation in interpreting the approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread. The findings establish proof of principle for VSV-based tracing while defining constraints that require further improvement for practical application.

papers.title_zh: 多种细胞因子信号通路的联合破坏使水疱性口炎病毒的一步顺行追踪成为可能。
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Defining the direct postsynaptic targets of selected neuronal populations remains a major challenge for neural circuit mapping. Vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) spreads efficiently in the anterograde direction, but replication-competent VSV undergoes multistep spread and therefore cannot distinguish direct from indirect downstream targets. Here, we developed a glycoprotein-deleted VSV(VSVdG)-based strategy for one-step anterograde tracing using AAV-mediated trans-complementation with several adaptations. In this system, VSVdG was engineered to encode Cre, allowing a Cre-dependent AAV to express VSV-G only after VSVdG infected the same cells, thereby limiting VSV-G expression to a short time window. To reduce VSV-M-mediated cytotoxicity, we introduced the M33A/M51R double-mutant VSV-Md variant. Using the basal ganglia circuit as a model, we found that efficient one-step VSVdG spread required disruption of cytokine-mediated antiviral responses triggered by AAV transduction and VSV infection. This was achieved by loss of type I interferon signaling in IFNAR1-knockout mice, together with suppression of additional antiviral responses either through AAV-mediated expression of the CVS-N2c rabies virus phosphoprotein or administration of cytokine-blocking antibody cocktail. These adaptations enabled VSVdG spread from dorsal striatum to expected downstream targets in mice of both sexes. However, the downstream labeled cells included both neurons and glia, revealing an important limitation for interpreting this approach as strictly neuron-to-neuron monosynaptic anterograde spread. Overall, rather than providing a ready-to-use tracing tool, this study presents a VSVdG strategy for one-step anterograde circuit tracing, and defines viral toxicity, innate immunity, and cell-type specificity constraints that must be addressed to develop an efficient and specific monosynaptic anterograde viral tracer. Significance Statement Mapping direct downstream targets of defined neuronal populations is essential for understanding neural circuit function, but reliable monosynaptic anterograde viral tracers remain limited. We developed a VSVdG-based strategy that uses AAV-mediated trans-complementation to restrict VSV-G expression to starter cells in a short time window and incorporates VSV-M variant to reduce toxicity. In the mouse basal ganglia, this system enabled one-step spread from dorsal striatum to expected output regions when innate antiviral barriers were suppressed. Our results identify type I interferon and additional type I/type II interferon-independent cytokine signaling as major restrictions of VSVdG spread. This study establishes proof of principle for VSV-based one-step anterograde tracing while defining viral toxicity, innate immunity, and cell-type specificity constraints in need of further improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 定义选定神经元群的直接突触后目标仍然是神经回路映射的主要挑战。水疱性口炎病毒 (VSV) 可沿顺行方向有效传播,但具有复制能力的 VSV 会经历多步传播,因此无法区分直接下游目标和间接目标。在这里,我们开发了一种基于糖蛋白删除的 VSV (VSVdG) 的策略,使用 AAV 介导的反式互补和多种适应进行一步顺行追踪。在该系统中,VSVdG被设计为编码Cre,使得Cre依赖性AAV仅在VSVdG感染相同细胞后才表达VSV-G,从而将VSV-G的表达限制在较短的时间窗口内。为了减少 VSV-M 介导的细胞毒性,我们引入了 M33A/M51R 双突变 VSV-Md 变体。使用基底神经节回路作为模型,我们发现有效的一步式 VSVdG 传播需要破坏由 AAV 转导和 VSV 感染触发的细胞因子介导的 抗病毒药物 反应。这是通过 IFNAR1 敲除小鼠中 I 型干扰素信号传导的丧失,以及通过 AAV 介导的 CVS-N2c 狂犬病病毒 磷蛋白表达或施用细胞因子阻断抗体混合物来抑制额外的 抗病毒药物 反应来实现的。这些适应使 VSVdG 从两性小鼠的背侧纹状体传播到预期的下游目标。然而,下游标记细胞包括神经元和神经胶质细胞,揭示了将这种方法解释为严格的神经元到神经元单突触顺行传播的一个重要限制。总体而言,本研究不是提供一种即用型追踪工具,而是提出了一种用于一步顺行回路追踪的 VSVdG 策略,并定义了病毒毒性、先天免疫和细胞类型特异性限制,开发一种高效且特异性的单突触顺行病毒示踪剂必须解决这些限制。意义陈述 绘制确定的神经元群体的直接下游目标对于理解神经回路功能至关重要,但可靠的单突触顺行病毒示踪剂仍然有限。我们开发了一种基于 VSVdG 的策略,该策略使用 AAV 介导的反式互补在短时间内限制起始细胞中 VSV-G 的表达,并合并 VSV-M 变体以降低毒性。在小鼠基底神经节中,当先天 抗病毒药物 屏障受到抑制时,该系统能够实现从背侧纹状体到预期输出区域的一步传播。我们的结果确定 I 型干扰素和其他 I/II 型干扰素独立的细胞因子信号传导是 VSVdG 传播的主要限制。这项研究为基于 VSV 的一步顺行追踪建立了原理证明,同时定义了需要进一步改进的病毒毒性、先天免疫和细胞类型特异性限制。

papers.title: Spatially resolved synaptic connectome mapping with FISH-decodable CASS barcodes.
papers.abstract: Mapping neuronal connectivity is essential for understanding the structure and function of neural circuits. While high-throughput, cost-effective methods using barcoded rabies viruses provide valuable cellular-level insights, they are limited by the spatial resolution of barcode sequencing. To provide a fluorescent in situ hybridization (FISH)-compatible alternative for spatial barcode readout, we developed the CASS (combination of artificial short sequences) barcode, an error-robust and in situ-hybridization-detectable tool. By combining CASS barcoding with rabies virus monosynaptic tracing, we enable in situ connectome mapping through FISH-based barcode decoding. Using this approach, we identified 1,532 synaptic pairs connected to neurons in the primary visual cortex with spatial precision across three mice, demonstrating its efficiency and scalability. This method provides a FISH-based approach for identifying neuronal connectivity with spatial context and may facilitate future integration of connectivity mapping with molecular profiling, thereby advancing our understanding of neural circuits.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Mapping neuronal connectivity is essential for understanding the structure and function of neural circuits. The study aimed to address the limitations of current methods by developing a new approach for spatially resolved connectome mapping.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved three mice and focused on the primary visual cortex. It combined CASS barcoding with rabies virus monosynaptic tracing to enable in situ connectome mapping through FISH-based barcode decoding.
analysis.methods: The methods included the development of CASS barcodes as a FISH-compatible alternative for spatial barcode readout. These barcodes were combined with rabies virus monosynaptic tracing to map synaptic connectivity with high precision.
analysis.main_results: Using the developed approach, the study identified 1,532 synaptic pairs connected to neurons in the primary visual cortex across three mice, demonstrating the efficiency and scalability of the method.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as evidence of the method's effectiveness in providing spatial context for neuronal connectivity. This approach represents a novel way to integrate connectivity mapping with molecular profiling.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform future research on neural circuits and their molecular underpinnings, potentially advancing our understanding of brain function and disease mechanisms.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to three mice and a specific brain region, which may affect generalizability. The evidence is moderate, as the results are based on a single experimental approach without broader validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the limitations of current high-throughput methods for mapping neuronal connectivity by developing a new approach using CASS barcodes compatible with FISH. The method combined CASS barcoding with rabies virus monosynaptic tracing to enable spatially resolved connectome mapping. Using this approach, the researchers identified 1,532 synaptic pairs in the primary visual cortex of three mice, demonstrating its efficiency and scalability. The findings suggest that this method could advance our understanding of neural circuits by integrating connectivity mapping with molecular profiling. However, the study is limited to a small sample size and a specific brain region, which may affect the generalizability of the results. papers.title_zh: 基于FISH可解码CASS条形码的空间分辨突触连接组映射
papers.source_body_en: Mapping neuronal connectivity is essential for understanding the structure and function of neural circuits. While high-throughput, cost-effective methods using barcoded rabies viruses provide valuable cellular-level insights, they are limited by the spatial resolution of barcode sequencing. To provide a fluorescent in situ hybridization (FISH)-compatible alternative for spatial barcode readout, we developed the CASS (combination of artificial short sequences) barcode, an error-robust and in situ-hybridization-detectable tool. By combining CASS barcoding with rabies virus monosynaptic tracing, we enable in situ connectome mapping through FISH-based barcode decoding. Using this approach, we identified 1,532 synaptic pairs connected to neurons in the primary visual cortex with spatial precision across three mice, demonstrating its efficiency and scalability. This method provides a FISH-based approach for identifying neuronal connectivity with spatial context and may facilitate future integration of connectivity mapping with molecular profiling, thereby advancing our understanding of neural circuits.

papers.title: Single-neuron connectome of nucleus accumbens.
papers.abstract: The nucleus accumbens (NAc) orchestrates a range of critical physiological functions, including reward and motivation, yet single-neuron-level connectivity of its inputs and outputs remains less comprehensively characterized. Here, we examined the organizing principle of input and projection of medium spiny neurons (MSNs) across NAc in adult male mice at single-cell resolution. Our results revealed topographic distribution principles of these neurons and their terminals in the substantia innominata (SI) subdivision. Rabies virus tracing uncovered different monosynaptic inputs to Tac2 + (D1 subtype) versus Calcr + (D2 subtype) MSNs across NAc subregions. Furthermore, cortical neurons projecting to NAc core or shell showed distinct cortical origins and collateralization. Hippocampal neurons projecting to the NAc preferentially innervate the core and medial shell with longitudinal topography and the strongest co-projection to the hypothalamus. Together, these data delineated the neuronal connectivity patterns of different neuronal subtypes in NAc, providing an anatomical basis for further understanding the neural circuit mechanisms underlying the functional role of NAc.

papers.title: Distinguishing dog-bite and rabies vulnerability in children to strengthen global elimination efforts
papers.abstract: Dog-mediated rabies remains a preventable cause of mortality in children, particularly in low- and middle-income countries where free-roaming dogs are common. While the WHO-led “Zero by 30” strategy emphasises mass dog vaccination and access to post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), less attention has been paid to the behavioural and communication pathways that shape children’s vulnerability. This Viewpoint proposes a conceptual distinction between vulnerability to dog bites and vulnerability to rabies following exposure. Conflating these risks may contribute to diffuse messaging and missed prevention opportunities. This Viewpoint argues for a differentiated child-facing and adult-facing interventions, with schools positioned as adaptable platforms for integrating safe behaviour, disclosure, and timely care-seeking within existing systems. Aligning behavioural, educational, and biomedical components more explicitly may strengthen implementation of global rabies elimination strategies and reduce paediatric deaths.

papers.title: Genome skimming resolves Neotropical population structure and mitonuclear discordance in the common vampire bat (Desmodus rotundus)
papers.abstract: Abstract Across the Neotropics, the common vampire bat ( Desmodus rotundus ) is an obligate hematophage, feeding on wildlife, domestic animals, and occasionally humans. While Desmodus is ecologically significant (e.g., nutrient cycling, complex sociality, parasitism), its role as a pathogen reservoir and vector (i.e., rabies virus) poses risks to animal and human health and local economies. Traditional single-gene and mitochondrial markers suggest high intra-species diversity within Desmodus ; however, next-generation sequencing and bioinformatic advancements enable comprehensive whole-genome analyses to resolve complex evolutionary histories. Here, we employed nanopore-based whole-genome skimming (~ 0.35X coverage) of 67 D. rotundus individuals across nine countries to characterize both nuclear and mitochondrial genomic diversity. Approximately 43 million mapped reads and 41 million loci informed our genotype likelihood analysis with the ANGSD: Analysis of Next Generation Sequencing Data software. We additionally assembled 28 complete mitogenomes along with 61 COI and 60 CYTB consensus genes. Our analysis revealed mitonuclear discordance patterns across the Neotropics. Genome-wide F ST values ranged from 0.114 to 0.358, with nuclear PCA and ancestry population structure modeling clustering populations along a continuous geographic gradient and mapping a latitudinal genetic transition zone through Panama. Conversely, mitogenomic phylogenies and maternal population structure models resolved highly structured, isolated regional lineages, including maternal divergence across the Ecuadorian Andes and localized matrilineal sorting in Guyana. This mitonuclear discordance suggests male-mediated gene flow and identifies Panama as a critical corridor and the Andes as a primary barrier to gene flow, supporting population isolation in Pleistocene refugia. Our findings refine the evolutionary history of Desmodus and demonstrate the utility of genome skimming for resolving wildlife lineages.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 线粒体核不一致表明男性介导的基因流动,并将巴拿马确定为关键走廊,将安第斯山脉确定为基因流动的主要障碍,支持更新世避难所中的种群隔离。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现完善了 Desmodus 的进化历史,并证明了 基因组 撇读在解决野生动物谱系方面的效用,这可以为未来的 狂犬病病毒 传播 和生态学研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于 基因组 略读,覆盖范围约为 0.35 倍,这可能会限制遗传变异的分辨率。由于基因组数据可能不完整,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Peer Review Report For: Development and characterization of pseudotype-based microneutralization assay to assess functionality of anti-rabies protein G antibodies [version 1; peer review: 2 approved with reservations]
papers.abstract: Background Rabies virus (RABV) is a neurotropic zoonotic pathogen responsible for an estimated 60,000 human deaths annually. Despite widespread vaccination programs, rabies remains a substantial public health burden, particularly in regions with limited access to post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Standard serological assays for evaluating rabies vaccine immunogenicity, including the Rapid Fluorescent Focus Inhibition Test (RFFIT) and the Fluorescent Antibody Virus Neutralization (FAVN) test, require live virus handling under biosafety level 3 (BSL-3) conditions, limiting their scalability and broader implementation. Methods We developed and characterized a pseudotype-based microneutralization assay using a lentiviral HIV-1 backbone to generate pseudotyped viral particles expressing glycoproteins from three antigenically distinct rabies virus strains: CTN-1 V5, CVS-11, and Pasteur. Neutralization assays were performed under BSL-2 conditions, and assay performance was evaluated in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and suitability for high-throughput applications. Results The pseudotype-based assay enabled sensitive and reproducible detection of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies across the three glycoprotein variants. The platform demonstrated robust performance under BSL-2 containment, supporting efficient and scalable testing. Inclusion of antigenically distinct strains broadened detection capacity and improved the assessment of strain-specific neutralizing responses. Conclusions This pseudotype-based microneutralization assay represents a safe, flexible, and scalable alternative to conventional live-virus neutralization tests. By enabling high-throughput rabies serology under BSL-2 conditions, this platform supports vaccine evaluation and seroepidemiological surveillance, particularly in settings where BSL-3 infrastructure is limited.

Despite widespread vaccination programs, rabies remains a substantial public health burden, particularly in regions with limited access to post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Standard serological assays for evaluating rabies vaccine immunogenicity, including the Rapid Fluorescent Focus Inhibition Test (RFFIT) and the Fluorescent Antibody Virus Neutralization (FAVN) test, require live virus handling under biosafety level 3 (BSL-3) conditions, limiting their scalability and broader implementation. Methods We developed and characterized a pseudotype-based microneutralization assay using a lentiviral HIV-1 backbone to generate pseudotyped viral particles expressing glycoproteins from three antigenically distinct rabies virus strains: CTN-1 V5, CVS-11, and Pasteur. Neutralization assays were performed under BSL-2 conditions, and assay performance was evaluated in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and suitability for high-throughput applications. Results The pseudotype-based assay enabled sensitive and reproducible detection of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies across the three glycoprotein variants. The platform demonstrated robust performance under BSL-2 containment, supporting efficient and scalable testing. Inclusion of antigenically distinct strains broadened detection capacity and improved the assessment of strain-specific neutralizing responses. Conclusions This pseudotype-based microneutralization assay represents a safe, flexible, and scalable alternative to conventional live-virus neutralization tests. By enabling high-throughput rabies serology under BSL-2 conditions, this platform supports vaccine evaluation and seroepidemiological surveillance, particularly in settings where BSL-3 infrastructure is limited.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 是一种嗜神经性人畜共患病原体,每年估计导致 60,000 人死亡。尽管 疫苗接种 计划广泛传播,但 狂犬病 仍然是巨大的公共卫生负担,特别是在 暴露后预防 (PEP) 获取机会有限的地区。用于评估 狂犬病 疫苗 免疫原性的标准血清学测定,包括快速荧光聚焦抑制试验 (RFFIT) 和荧光抗体病毒中和 (FAVN) 试验,需要在生物安全 3 级 (BSL-3) 条件下处理活病毒,限制了其可扩展性和更广泛的实施。方法我们开发并表征了一种基于假型的微中和测定,使用慢病毒 HIV-1 主链生成表达来自三种抗原不同的 狂犬病病毒 菌株(CTN-1 V5、CVS-11 和巴斯德)的糖蛋白的假型病毒颗粒。中和测定在 BSL-2 条件下进行,并从灵敏度、特异性和高通量应用的适用性方面评估测定性能。结果基于假型的测定能够灵敏且可重复地检测三种糖蛋白变体的 狂犬病病毒 中和抗体。该平台在 BSL-2 遏制下表现出强大的性能,支持高效且可扩展的测试。包含抗原性不同的菌株扩大了检测能力并改进了菌株特异性中和反应的评估。结论 这种基于假型的微量中和试验是传统活病毒中和试验的一种安全、灵活且可扩展的替代方法。通过在 BSL-2 条件下启用高通量 狂犬病 血清学,该平台支持 疫苗 评估和血清流行病学 监测,特别是在 BSL-3 基础设施有限的环境中。

papers.title: Whole-Brain Monosynaptic Inputs and Outputs of Corticotropin-Releasing Hormone Neurons of the Paraventricular Nucleus of the Hypothalamus in Male Mice.
papers.abstract: Objective The paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (PVN) is a central hub integrating neuroendocrine, autonomic, and behavioral responses. Corticotropin-releasing hormone (CRH) neurons in the PVN (PVN CRH ) play a pivotal role in stress responses, anxiety, and motivation. However, the brain-wide monosynaptic input-output architecture of PVN CRH neurons remains incompletely defined, limiting circuit-based functional dissection. Methods Using Cre-dependent modified rabies virus for retrograde monosynaptic tracing and adeno-associated viruses for anterograde tracing in CRH-Cre mice, we systematically mapped the whole-brain inputs and outputs of PVN CRH neurons. Results PVN CRH neurons received direct inputs from 55 brain regions, with a predominant contribution from diencephalon areas and an overall ipsilateral bias (61.4%). Notably, highly specific inputs originated from the ventral hippocampal CA1 and nucleus accumbens core. PVN CRH neurons also sent widespread axonal projections throughout the brain. These outputs converge onto multiple circuit modules, with dense projections to emotion-related nuclei and autonomic regulatory centers. Conclusion This study establishes a comprehensive whole-brain monosynaptic input-output atlas of PVN CRH neurons. The resultant neuroanatomical framework delineates their extensive connectivity with stress-, emotion-, autonomic-, and respiration-related circuits, providing a structural basis for future circuit-level investigations into stress-related psychiatric disorders and systemic autonomic dysregulation.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在使用CRH-Cre小鼠的雄性小鼠中进行,以系统地绘制PVN CRH神经元的全脑输入和输出。研究时间从2026-09-01开始,采用了一种全面的方法来研究神经连接性。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员在 CRH-Cre 小鼠中使用 Cre 依赖性修饰的 狂犬病病毒 进行逆行单突触追踪,并使用腺相关病毒进行顺行追踪,以绘制 PVN CRH 神经元的全脑输入和输出图。
elements_zh.main_results: PVN CRH 神经元接收来自 55 个大脑区域的直接输入,其中主要贡献来自间脑区域和总体同侧偏差 (61.4%)。高度特异性的输入源自腹侧海马 CA1 和伏隔核核心。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究通过描绘 PVN CRH 神经元的广泛连接性,为未来对压力相关精神疾病和系统性自主神经失调的回路水平研究提供了结构基础。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了对涉及压力、情绪和自主神经调节的神经回路的见解,这可以为未来有关压力相关精神疾病和系统性自主神经失调的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于雄性小鼠,证据基于综合绘图方法,该方法提供了对 PVN CRH 神经元连接模式的高置信度评估。

papers.title_zh: 雄性小鼠下丘脑室旁核促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素神经元的全脑单突触输入和输出。
papers.source_body_en: Objective The paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (PVN) is a central hub integrating neuroendocrine, autonomic, and behavioral responses. papers.abstract_zh: 目的 下丘脑室旁核(PVN)是整合神经内分泌、自主神经和行为反应的中枢。PVN 中的促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素 (CRH) 神经元 (PVN CRH ) 在应激反应、焦虑和动机中发挥着关键作用。然而,PVN CRH 神经元的全脑单突触输入输出架构仍未完全定义,限制了基于电路的功能解剖。方法使用 Cre 依赖性修饰的 狂犬病病毒 进行逆行单突触追踪,并使用腺相关病毒进行 CRH-Cre 小鼠的顺行追踪,我们系统地绘制了 PVN CRH 神经元的全脑输入和输出。结果 PVN CRH 神经元接收来自 55 个大脑区域的直接输入,其中主要贡献来自间脑区域和总体同侧偏差 (61.4%)。值得注意的是,高度特异性的输入源自腹侧海马 CA1 和伏隔核核心。PVN CRH 神经元还在整个大脑中发出广泛的轴突投射。这些输出汇聚到多个电路模块上,并密集投射到与情绪相关的核团和自主调节中心。结论本研究建立了一个全面的PVN CRH神经元全脑单突触输入输出图谱。由此产生的神经解剖学框架描绘了它们与压力、情绪、自主神经和呼吸相关回路的广泛连接,为未来对压力相关精神疾病和系统性自主神经失调的回路水平研究提供了结构基础。

papers.title: Reconstructing the molecular epidemiology of rabies in Switzerland from outbreak to elimination (1967–1997)
papers.abstract: Abstract Rabies virus (RABV) is a lethal zoonotic pathogen that remains endemic in some parts of the world despite long-standing vaccination efforts. We present a comprehensive genomic and evolutionary analysis of the sylvatic rabies epidemic in Switzerland (1967–1997) and propose a molecular epidemiological framework describing RABV dynamics from emergence to elimination, with relevance for countries pursuing wildlife rabies elimination. We generated almost whole-genome sequences from 88 RABV-positive brain samples collected across 17 Swiss cantons and 13 host species over three decades. Using Illumina sequencing, 76 genomes were recovered at high coverage, enabling robust Single Nucleotide Polymorphism (SNP) and molecular clock analyses. Phylogenetic reconstruction based on Swiss whole genomes and glycoprotein sequences including additional European strains identified three temporally structured RABV lineages—red (1967–1976), blue (1976–1988), and green (1984–1996)—each consistent with independent introductions from neighbouring countries. Evolutionary analyses indicated a slow substitution rate and predominant purifying selection, with limited adaptive amino-acid change. However, four mutations emerged during the epidemiological peak, suggesting possible modest fitness effects. We found no evidence of major genomic changes associated with cross-species spillovers. Four synonymous variants were underrepresented in carnivore hosts; however, larger datasets may provide stronger evidence for host-associated genetic differences. Genetic divergence showed a strong temporal signal and moderate correlation with geographic distance, consistent with natural and vaccination-induced barriers limiting RABV dispersal, in agreement with the known ecology and control history of the epidemic. These findings provide a genomic framework for understanding sylvatic rabies emergence and elimination and may inform strategies to achieve and sustain the World Health Organization (WHO) goal of zero human deaths from dog-mediated rabies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Rabies virus (RABV) remains endemic in some parts of the world despite long-standing vaccination efforts. This study aimed to understand the molecular epidemiology of rabies in Switzerland from outbreak to elimination.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A comprehensive genomic and evolutionary analysis was conducted on the sylvatic rabies epidemic in Switzerland between 1967 and 1997. The study included 88 RABV-positive brain samples collected across 17 Swiss cantons and 13 host species over three decades.
analysis.methods: Almost whole-genome sequences were generated from 88 RABV-positive brain samples using Illumina sequencing. 76 genomes were recovered at high coverage, enabling robust Single Nucleotide Polymorphism (SNP) and molecular clock analyses.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic reconstruction identified three temporally structured RABV lineages—red (1967–1976), blue (1976–1988), and green (1984–1996)—each consistent with independent introductions from neighboring countries. Genetic divergence showed a strong temporal signal and moderate correlation with geographic distance.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provide a genomic framework for understanding sylvatic rabies emergence and elimination, offering insights into the dynamics of RABV spread and the impact of vaccination efforts.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform strategies to achieve and sustain the World Health Organization (WHO) goal of zero human deaths from dog-mediated rabies by highlighting the role of natural and vaccination-induced barriers in limiting RABV dispersal.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study found no evidence of major genomic changes associated with cross-species spillovers, and four synonymous variants were underrepresented in carnivore hosts. However, larger datasets may provide stronger evidence for host-associated genetic differences.

analysis.summary_en: This study reconstructs the molecular epidemiology of rabies virus (RABV) in Switzerland from 1967 to 1997, analyzing 88 RABV-positive brain samples across 17 cantons and 13 host species. Using Illumina sequencing, 76 genomes were recovered at high coverage, enabling SNP and molecular clock analyses. Phylogenetic reconstruction identified three temporally structured RABV lineages, each consistent with independent introductions from neighboring countries. Genetic divergence showed a strong temporal signal and moderate correlation with geographic distance, suggesting natural and vaccination-induced barriers limited RABV dispersal. The study found no evidence of major genomic changes associated with cross-species spillovers, but four mutations emerged during the epidemiological peak, possibly indicating modest fitness effects. These findings provide a genomic framework for understanding sylvatic rabies emergence and elimination, with implications for strategies to achieve the WHO goal of zero human deaths from dog-mediated rabies. The study's evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of major genomic changes and the potential need for larger datasets to confirm host-associated genetic differences.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管 疫苗接种 做出了长期努力,但 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 在世界某些地区仍然流行。本研究旨在了解瑞士狂犬病的分子流行病学从暴发到消除。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 1967 年至 1997 年间瑞士森林 狂犬病 流行病进行了全面的基因组和进化分析。该研究包括三十年来从瑞士 17 个州和 13 个 宿主 物种收集的 88 个 RABV 阳性大脑样本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 Illumina 测序从 88 个 RABV 阳性大脑样本中生成几乎完整的 基因组 序列。76 基因组 以高覆盖率恢复,从而实现稳健的单核苷酸多态性 (SNP) 和分子钟分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育重建确定了三个时间结构的RABV谱系——红色(1967-1976)、蓝色(1976-1988)和绿色(1984-1996)——每个谱系都与从邻国独立引入的情况一致。遗传分化表现出强烈的时间信号和与地理距离的中等相关性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为理解森林狂犬病的出现和消除提供了一个基因组框架,为RABV传播的动态和狂犬病努力的影响提供了见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以通过强调自然和 狂犬病 诱导的障碍在限制 RABV 传播方面的作用,为实现和维持世界卫生组织 (WHO) 狗介导的 狂犬病 导致人类零死亡的目标提供策略依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有发现与跨物种 跨物种溢出 相关的主要基因组变化的证据,并且四种同义变异在食肉动物 宿主 中代表性不足。然而,更大的数据集可能为 宿主 相关的遗传差异提供更有力的证据。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 是一种致命的人畜共患病原体,尽管经过长期的 疫苗接种 努力,该病原体在世界某些地区仍然流行。我们对瑞士森林 狂犬病 流行病(1967-1997 年)进行了全面的基因组和进化分析,并提出了一个描述 RABV 从出现到消除的动态的分子流行病学框架,与追求消除野生动物 狂犬病 的国家相关。我们从三十年来在瑞士 17 个州和 13 个 宿主 物种收集的 88 个 RABV 阳性大脑样本中生成了几乎完整的 基因组 序列。使用 Illumina 测序,以高覆盖度回收了 76 个 基因组,从而实现了稳健的单核苷酸多态性 (SNP) 和分子钟分析。基于瑞士完整 基因组 和糖蛋白序列(包括其他欧洲毒株)的系统发育重建确定了三个时间结构的 RABV 谱系——红色(1967-1976)、蓝色(1976-1988)和绿色(1984-1996)——每个谱系都与来自邻国的独立引入一致。进化分析表明缓慢的取代率和主要的纯化选择,以及有限的适应性氨基酸变化。然而,在流行病学高峰期间出现了四个 突变,这表明健身效果可能不大。我们没有发现与跨物种 跨物种溢出 相关的主要基因组变化的证据。四种同义变异在食肉动物 宿主 中代表性不足;然而,更大的数据集可能为 宿主 相关的遗传差异提供更有力的证据。遗传分化显示出强烈的时间信号和与地理距离的中度相关性,与限制RABV传播的自然和疫苗接种诱导的障碍一致,与已知的流行病生态和控制历史一致。这些发现为理解森林狂犬病的出现和消除提供了一个基因组框架,并可能为实现和维持世界卫生组织(WHO)由狗介导的狂犬病造成的人类零死亡的目标提供策略。

papers.title: Dog related diseases affecting humans: a comprehensive survey of zoonotic infections from case studies in China and Zambia
papers.abstract: Rabies is a highly fatal and transmissible zoonotic disease, causing approximately 59,000 human deaths each year across more than 150 countries, with over 95% of cases occurring in Asia and Africa and imposing a substantial public health burden. It remains one of the most serious dog-mediated zoonoses in both China and Zambia. In Zambia, periodic outbreaks are driven by domestic dogs as the principal reservoir, placing rural children at especially high risk, while inland provinces of China continue to experience dog-mediated rabies incidence. Beyond rabies, emerging threats such as blood-borne pathogens lack systematic quantification. This study provides a direct epidemiological comparison between the two countries to inform targeted interventions. The study employed mixed methods, including a quota-sampled, cross-sectional observational survey based on the Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices (KAP) framework and focus group discussions (n = 39), surveying residents in Hainan (n = 2,388) and Mambwe (n = 433). While most participants held positive attitudes toward rabies, significant gaps emerged in both knowledge and practice. Common deficits included (1) a lack of awareness that rabies is incurable, (2) insufficient knowledge regarding the transmission pathways of rabies, and (3) limited understanding of the risks posed by seemingly healthy dogs. In Mambwe specifically, additional issues were identified: (4) low coverage of dog registration and vaccination and (5) widespread practices of free-roaming dog ownership. To control and ultimately eliminate rabies, we recommend context‐specific strategies: (1) enforcing strict boundaries between human settlements and wildlife conservation areas; (2) investing in rural infrastructure; (3) enhancing community engagement; and (4) adopting One Health approach. In Mambwe District, blood samples were collected from 277 domestic dogs owned by farmers living adjacent to the national park boundary. Metagenomic sequencing using Oxford Nanopore Technologies revealed six pathogenic microbial species or subspecies: Anaplasma platys, Ehrlichia canis, Pasteurella multocida, Trypanosoma congolense IL3000, Trypanosoma brucei, and Trypanosoma brucei brucei. These pathogens pose significant cross‐species transmission and zoonotic spillover risks, threatening human health, livestock productivity, and wildlife conservation. Notably, Pasteurella multocida was detected in Zambian dogs for the first time. These findings provide detailed insight into the role of domestic dogs within this distinctive agricultural system and establish a scientific foundation for future One Health management strategies and policy development. They are expected to inform the refinement of rabies policies and targeted control measures in Asia and Africa, thereby supporting the prevention of dog‐associated diseases.

papers.abstract_zh: 狂犬病 是一种高度致命、可传播的人畜共患疾病,每年在 150 多个国家造成约 59,000 人死亡,其中 95% 以上的病例发生在亚洲和非洲,给公共卫生造成巨大负担。它仍然是中国和赞比亚最严重的狗介导的人畜共患病之一。在赞比亚,周期性的暴发是由家犬驱动的,作为主要的储存宿主,使农村儿童面临特别高的风险,而中国内陆省份继续经历以狗为媒介的狂犬病 发病率。除了 狂犬病 之外,血源性病原体等新兴威胁缺乏系统的量化。这项研究提供了两国之间的直接流行病学比较,以便为有针对性的干预措施提供信息。该研究采用混合方法,包括基于知识、态度和实践(KAP)框架的配额抽样、横断面观察调查和焦点小组讨论(n = 39),对海南(n = 2,388)和曼布韦(n = 433)的居民进行调查。虽然大多数参与者对 狂犬病 持积极态度,但在知识和实践方面都出现了巨大差距。常见缺陷包括(1)缺乏对 狂犬病 无法治愈的认识,(2)对 狂犬病 的 传播 通路了解不足,以及(3)对看似健康的狗所带来的风险了解有限。特别是在曼布韦,还发现了其他问题:(4) 狗登记和 疫苗接种 覆盖率低,以及 (5) 养狗自由漫游的普遍做法。为了控制并最终消除狂犬病,我们建议针对具体情况的策略:(1)在人类住区和野生动物保护区之间执行严格的界限;(二)投资农村基础设施;(3) 加强社区参与;(4) 采用“同一个健康”方法。在 Mambwe 地区,从国家公园边界附近农民拥有的 277 只家养狗身上采集了血液样本。使用牛津纳米孔技术的宏基因组测序揭示了六种致病微生物物种或亚种:扁平无形体、犬埃利希体、多杀性巴斯德氏菌、刚果锥虫 IL3000、布氏锥虫和布氏锥虫。这些病原体构成重大的跨物种 传播 和人畜共患 跨物种溢出 风险,威胁人类健康、牲畜生产力和野生动物保护。值得注意的是,首次在赞比亚狗身上检测到多杀性巴氏杆菌。这些发现提供了对家犬在这一独特农业系统中的作用的详细见解,并为未来的 One Health 管理战略和政策制定奠定了科学基础。预计它们将为亚洲和非洲 狂犬病 政策和有针对性的控制措施的完善提供信息,从而支持与狗相关的疾病的预防。

papers.title: Public awareness and knowledge on rabies: a survey-based analysis
papers.abstract: Background: Rabies is a fatal yet preventable viral disease that attacks the central nervous system and is endemic in more than 150 countries. Despite advancements in vaccines and treatments, rabies remains a neglected tropical disease. Therefore, present study aims to assess the awareness and knowledge about rabies among general population. Methods: Quantitative descriptive cross-sectional survey research design was used to conduct the study. A sample of 567 participants from general population was selected for the study using random sampling technique from social media platform across India. Results: Study revealed that overall, 68.43% participants were aware about transmission of rabies, 48.68% participants were knowledgeable about symptoms of rabies and 69.49% participants had knowledge about preventive measures about rabies. There was no significant association found between awareness regarding transmission of rabies, symptoms of rabies and preventive measures of rabies with any of demographic variables of the participants Conclusions: Study concluded that there was a mild to moderate level of knowledge among general population. Hence, proper awareness regarding various rabies diseases and its prevention can help in reducing such risk among general population.
papers.journal: International Journal Of Community Medicine And Public Health

analysis.research_question_and_background: Rabies is a fatal yet preventable viral CNS disease endemic in more than 150 countries and remains a neglected tropical disease despite vaccine and treatment advances, and the present study aimed to assess awareness and knowledge about rabies among the general population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A quantitative descriptive cross-sectional survey was conducted across India using a random sampling technique via a social media platform, recruiting 567 participants from the general population.
analysis.methods: A quantitative descriptive cross-sectional survey design was administered as an online questionnaire distributed through a social media platform, drawing a random sample of 567 participants from the general population across India.
analysis.main_results: Among 567 participants, 68.43% were aware of rabies transmission, 48.68% were knowledgeable about rabies symptoms, and 69.49% knew preventive measures, and no significant association was found between awareness of transmission, symptoms or preventive measures and any demographic variable.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that only a mild to moderate level of rabies-related knowledge existed among the surveyed general population in India, highlighting persistent knowledge gaps even though basic transmission awareness exceeded preventive and symptom knowledge.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Improving public awareness of rabies disease and prevention through targeted education campaigns could help reduce rabies-related risk among the general population in endemic countries such as India.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Limitations include reliance on a single social-media platform with random sampling, restriction to participants from one country, absence of demographic associations, and an abstract-only evidence base that precludes assessment of questionnaire validity, yielding a moderate overall confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: Rabies is a fatal yet preventable viral CNS disease endemic in more than 150 countries and remains a neglected tropical disease despite advances in vaccines and treatments. To address gaps in public understanding, a quantitative descriptive cross-sectional survey was conducted across India using a random sampling technique distributed through a social media platform. A total of 567 participants from the general population completed the questionnaire. The study found that 68.43% of participants were aware of rabies transmission, 48.68% were knowledgeable about rabies symptoms, and 69.49% knew preventive measures. However, no significant association was identified between awareness of transmission, symptoms, or preventive measures and any demographic variable. The authors concluded that the surveyed population demonstrated only a mild to moderate level of rabies-related knowledge, with symptom knowledge notably lower than transmission awareness. They recommended that improved public awareness and education about rabies and its prevention could help reduce risk in the general population. papers.source_body_en: Background: Rabies is a fatal yet preventable viral disease that attacks the central nervous system and is endemic in more than 150 countries. Despite advancements in vaccines and treatments, rabies remains a neglected tropical disease. Therefore, present study aims to assess the awareness and knowledge about rabies among general population. Methods: Quantitative descriptive cross-sectional survey research design was used to conduct the study. A sample of 567 participants from general population was selected for the study using random sampling technique from social media platform across India. Results: Study revealed that overall, 68.43% participants were aware about transmission of rabies, 48.68% participants were knowledgeable about symptoms of rabies and 69.49% participants had knowledge about preventive measures about rabies. There was no significant association found between awareness regarding transmission of rabies, symptoms of rabies and preventive measures of rabies with any of demographic variables of the participants Conclusions: Study concluded that there was a mild to moderate level of knowledge among general population. Hence, proper awareness regarding various rabies diseases and its prevention can help in reducing such risk among general population.

papers.title: Suspected case of rabies in a patient immunized with anti-rabies vaccine
papers.abstract: Rabies remains a major public health threat, especially in developing countries like India, where stray dogs account for 99% of human cases. The disease is almost always fatal once symptoms appear, with death occurring within days. Despite highly effective pre- and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) with WHO-recommended vaccines, challenges like occasional vaccine failure persist. In India, rabies causes approximately 20,000 deaths annually. This case highlights a suspected rabies infection that developed despite receiving PEP, exploring potential reasons for the failure. This case emphasizes the necessity for a deeper understanding of factors that may lead to vaccine ineffectiveness. It also underscores the critical role of administering rabies immunoglobulin (RIG), proper wound care and following established guidelines.
papers.journal: International Journal Of Community Medicine And Public Health

papers.title: Biological barriers underlying the extremely high fatality of symptomatic rabies: neuroinvasion, immune evasion, and blood–brain barrier restriction
papers.abstract: Rabies remains one of the most preventable fatal infections, yet once clinical symptoms appear, survival is exceedingly rare. This paradox cannot be explained simply by the absence of a single effective antiviral drug. In this review, we frame symptomatic rabies as a sequential barrier-driven disease process in which neuroinvasion, immune evasion, and blood–brain barrier restriction converge to make post-symptom rescue biologically difficult. Rabies virus first changes the anatomical battlefield by entering peripheral nerves, exploiting receptor-supported uptake and retrograde axonal transport, and establishing infection within protected neural circuits. It then delays the host counterattack through weak or strain-dependent innate sensing, viral interference with interferon and signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT) signaling, and insufficient conversion of peripheral immune activation into effective central nervous system clearance. Once central nervous system (CNS) infection is established, blood–brain barrier restriction further limits access of neutralizing antibodies, antiviral compounds, biologics, and immune cells to infected neural tissue. The convergence of these barriers permits CNS persistence and drives fatal encephalopathy, characterized less by widespread neuronal destruction than by synaptic, dendritic, circuit, autonomic, and functional collapse. Recent experimental advances, including CNS-accessible antibody strategies, blood–brain barrier (BBB)-modulating approaches, monoclonal antibody therapy, and One Medicine models, suggest that symptomatic rabies may require stage-specific therapeutic combinations rather than a single rescue intervention. We propose that future rabies therapy should be organized around three translational windows: preventing neuroinvasion before CNS entry, achieving immune-assisted viral control during early CNS infection, and combining CNS viral clearance with neuroprotective and autonomic support once encephalopathy is established. However, most mechanistic and therapeutic evidence remains derived from cellular and animal models, and clinical validation of CNS-directed or barrier-targeted interventions in symptomatic human rabies remains limited. Breaking the barrier cascade may be the central requirement for making symptomatic rabies treatable.

analysis.scope_and_question: Rabies virus and rabies disease. The review focuses on the biological barriers that contribute to the extremely high fatality of symptomatic rabies, including neuroinvasion, immune evasion, and blood–brain barrier restriction. The central question is how these barriers make post-symptom rescue biologically difficult.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. The evidence is derived from experimental studies, including cellular and animal models, and clinical observations.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that rabies virus causes a sequential barrier-driven disease process, where neuroinvasion, immune evasion, and blood–brain barrier restriction converge to make post-symptom rescue biologically difficult. Once central nervous system (CNS) infection is established, the blood–brain barrier restricts access of therapeutic agents to infected neural tissue, leading to fatal encephalopathy.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that most mechanistic and therapeutic evidence remains derived from cellular and animal models, with limited clinical validation of CNS-directed or barrier-targeted interventions in symptomatic human rabies. There is also a lack of consensus on the exact mechanisms of immune evasion and blood–brain barrier restriction in human rabies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future rabies therapy should be organized around three translational windows: preventing neuroinvasion before CNS entry, achieving immune-assisted viral control during early CNS infection, and combining CNS viral clearance with neuroprotective and autonomic support once encephalopathy is established. It also highlights the need for clinical validation of interventions targeting the CNS or barriers.

These barriers make post-symptom rescue biologically difficult, as they prevent effective immune response and therapeutic intervention. The review highlights the need for stage-specific therapeutic strategies and calls for clinical validation of CNS-directed and barrier-targeted interventions. While recent experimental advances offer promising approaches, most evidence remains from animal and cellular models, underscoring the importance of further research and clinical trials to improve treatment outcomes for symptomatic rabies.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 狂犬病病毒 和 狂犬病 疾病。该综述重点关注导致有症状的 狂犬病 极高死亡率的生物屏障,包括神经侵袭、免疫逃避和血脑屏障限制。核心问题是这些障碍如何使症状后的救援在生物学上变得困难。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对现有文献的叙述性综合,没有明确提及系统搜索方法、数据库或荟萃分析。证据来自实验研究,包括细胞和动物模型以及临床观察。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: Rabies virus and rabies disease. The review focuses on the biological barriers that contribute to the extremely high fatality of symptomatic rabies, including neuroinvasion, immune evasion, and blood–brain barrier restriction. The central question is how these barriers make post-symptom rescue biologically difficult.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. The evidence is derived from experimental studies, including cellular and animal models, and clinical observations.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that rabies virus causes a sequential barrier-driven disease process, where neuroinvasion, immune evasion, and blood–brain barrier restriction converge to make post-symptom rescue biologically difficult. Once central nervous system (CNS) infection is established, the blood–brain barrier restricts access of therapeutic agents to infected neural tissue, leading to fatal encephalopathy.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that most mechanistic and therapeutic evidence remains derived from cellular and animal models, with limited clinical validation of CNS-directed or barrier-targeted interventions in symptomatic human rabies. There is also a lack of consensus on the exact mechanisms of immune evasion and blood–brain barrier restriction in human rabies.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future rabies therapy should be organized around three translational windows: preventing neuroinvasion before CNS entry, achieving immune-assisted viral control during early CNS infection, and combining CNS viral clearance with neuroprotective and autonomic support once encephalopathy is established. It also highlights the need for clinical validation of interventions targeting the CNS or barriers.

papers.title_zh: 症状性狂犬病极高致死率的潜在生物学屏障:神经侵袭、免疫逃逸和血脑屏障限制
papers.source_body_en: Rabies remains one of the most preventable fatal infections, yet once clinical symptoms appear, survival is exceedingly rare. This paradox cannot be explained simply by the absence of a single effective antiviral drug. In this review, we frame symptomatic rabies as a sequential barrier-driven disease process in which neuroinvasion, immune evasion, and blood–brain barrier restriction converge to make post-symptom rescue biologically difficult. Rabies virus first changes the anatomical battlefield by entering peripheral nerves, exploiting receptor-supported uptake and retrograde axonal transport, and establishing infection within protected neural circuits. It then delays the host counterattack through weak or strain-dependent innate sensing, viral interference with interferon and signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT) signaling, and insufficient conversion of peripheral immune activation into effective central nervous system clearance. Once central nervous system (CNS) infection is established, blood–brain barrier restriction further limits access of neutralizing antibodies, antiviral compounds, biologics, and immune cells to infected neural tissue. The convergence of these barriers permits CNS persistence and drives fatal encephalopathy, characterized less by widespread neuronal destruction than by synaptic, dendritic, circuit, autonomic, and functional collapse. Recent experimental advances, including CNS-accessible antibody strategies, blood–brain barrier (BBB)-modulating approaches, monoclonal antibody therapy, and One Medicine models, suggest that symptomatic rabies may require stage-specific therapeutic combinations rather than a single rescue intervention. We propose that future rabies therapy should be organized around three translational windows: preventing neuroinvasion before CNS entry, achieving immune-assisted viral control during early CNS infection, and combining CNS viral clearance with neuroprotective and autonomic support once encephalopathy is established. However, most mechanistic and therapeutic evidence remains derived from cellular and animal models, and clinical validation of CNS-directed or barrier-targeted interventions in symptomatic human rabies remains limited. Breaking the barrier cascade may be the central requirement for making symptomatic rabies treatable.
papers.abstract_zh: 狂犬病 仍然是最可预防的致命感染之一,但一旦出现临床症状,存活率极其罕见。这一悖论不能简单地用缺乏单一有效的 抗病毒药物 药物来解释。在这篇综述中,我们将症状性 狂犬病 定义为一个连续的屏障驱动的疾病过程,其中神经侵袭、免疫逃避和血脑屏障限制汇聚在一起,使症状后的救援在生物学上变得困难。狂犬病病毒 首先通过进入周围神经、利用受体支持的摄取和逆行轴突运输以及在受保护的神经回路内建立感染来改变解剖战场。然后,它通过微弱或依赖菌株的先天感应、病毒干扰干扰素和信号转导器和转录激活剂 (STAT) 信号传导以及外周免疫激活不充分转化为有效的中枢神经系统清除来延迟 宿主 反击。一旦中枢神经系统(CNS)感染建立,血脑屏障限制进一步限制中和抗体、抗病毒药物化合物、生物制剂和免疫细胞进入受感染的神经组织。这些屏障的汇聚使得中枢神经系统持续存在,并导致致命性脑病,其特征不是广泛的神经元破坏,而是突触、树突、回路、自主神经和功能崩溃。最近的实验进展,包括中枢神经系统可及抗体策略、血脑屏障 (BBB) 调节方法、单克隆抗体治疗和单一药物模型,表明有症状的 狂犬病 可能需要阶段特异性的治疗组合,而不是单一的救援干预。我们建议未来的 狂犬病 治疗应围绕三个转化窗口进行组织:在 CNS 进入之前预防神经侵袭,在早期 CNS 感染期间实现免疫辅助病毒控制,以及一旦脑病确立,将 CNS 病毒清除与神经保护和自主神经支持相结合。然而,大多数机制和治疗证据仍然来自细胞和动物模型,针对有症状的人类 狂犬病 的中枢神经系统定向或针对屏障的干预措施的临床验证仍然有限。打破级联屏障可能是使有症状的 狂犬病 可治疗的核心要求。

papers.title: Factors associated with delays in rabies post-exposure prophylaxis among international travelers in Barcelona
papers.abstract: Rabies is a fatal zoonosis that is usually preventable by prompt post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). International travellers to endemic areas may sustain animal-associated injuries (AAIs), but data on delays in PEP initiation remain scarce in Spain. We conducted a retrospective observational study of international travellers who attended the Adult Vaccination Centre of Hospital Clínic Barcelona between 1 January 2021 and 31 March 2025 after sustaining an AAI abroad. Electronic health records and vaccination registries were reviewed to collect sociodemographic data, travel details, AAI characteristics, vaccination history including PEP, and pre-travel advice. Outcomes were early vaccination (< 1 day from AAI) and delayed vaccination (≥ 3 days). Bivariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were conducted, with sensitivity analysis using Cox regression. A total of 203 travellers met inclusion criteria. Median age was 31 years (IQR 26–40), 49% were female and 40% foreign-born. Most patients (89%) had never received rabies vaccination, but 19% reported pre-travel advice. The most frequent exposures were bites (75%), mainly from dogs (44%), occurring predominantly in South-East Asia (32%). The median delay to first vaccine dose was 1 day (IQR 0–6); 26% received immunoglobulin. Delayed vaccination was associated with previous vaccination and AAIs in a region different from South-East Asia or Eastern Mediterranean. Not having been previously vaccinated and male sex were associated with higher odds of early initiation. Sensitivity analysis supported these findings. While most travellers began vaccination soon after exposure, delays were frequent and linked to individual characteristics. These findings highlight the need for improved pre-travel counselling, risk communication and post-exposure management. Larger multicentric studies with standardised definitions and innovative analyses are warranted to generate stronger evidence and optimise preventive strategies for rabies in international travellers.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines factors associated with delays in rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) among international travelers in Barcelona. The study, conducted between 2021 and 2025, analyzed 203 travelers who sustained animal-associated injuries abroad. Most travelers had not received rabies vaccination previously, but 19% had received pre-travel advice. The most common exposures were dog bites in South-East Asia. Delays in PEP initiation were linked to prior vaccination and exposures in regions other than South-East Asia or Eastern Mediterranean. Male sex and lack of prior vaccination were associated with higher odds of early initiation. Sensitivity analysis confirmed these findings. Despite most travelers initiating PEP promptly, delays were frequent and tied to individual characteristics. The study underscores the need for improved pre-travel counseling and post-exposure management. It calls for larger, multicentric studies with standardized definitions to enhance preventive strategies for rabies in international travelers.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们对 2021 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 3 月 31 日期间在国外维持 AAI 后到巴塞罗那医院诊所成人 疫苗接种 中心就诊的国际旅行者进行了一项回顾性观察研究。进行双变量和多变量逻辑回归分析,并使用 Cox 回归进行敏感性分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 大多数患者 (89%) 从未接受过 狂犬病 疫苗接种,但 19% 报告了旅行前建议。延迟的 疫苗接种 与之前的 疫苗接种 和 AAI 在不同于东南亚或东地中海的地区相关。之前未接种过疫苗且男性与早期接种疫苗的几率较高相关。敏感性分析支持了这些发现。

papers.source_body_en: Rabies is a fatal zoonosis that is usually preventable by prompt post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). International travellers to endemic areas may sustain animal-associated injuries (AAIs), but data on delays in PEP initiation remain scarce in Spain. We conducted a retrospective observational study of international travellers who attended the Adult Vaccination Centre of Hospital Clínic Barcelona between 1 January 2021 and 31 March 2025 after sustaining an AAI abroad. Electronic health records and vaccination registries were reviewed to collect sociodemographic data, travel details, AAI characteristics, vaccination history including PEP, and pre-travel advice. Outcomes were early vaccination (< 1 day from AAI) and delayed vaccination (≥ 3 days). Bivariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were conducted, with sensitivity analysis using Cox regression. A total of 203 travellers met inclusion criteria. Median age was 31 years (IQR 26–40), 49% were female and 40% foreign-born. Most patients (89%) had never received rabies vaccination, but 19% reported pre-travel advice. The most frequent exposures were bites (75%), mainly from dogs (44%), occurring predominantly in South-East Asia (32%). The median delay to first vaccine dose was 1 day (IQR 0–6); 26% received immunoglobulin. Delayed vaccination was associated with previous vaccination and AAIs in a region different from South-East Asia or Eastern Mediterranean. Not having been previously vaccinated and male sex were associated with higher odds of early initiation. Sensitivity analysis supported these findings. While most travellers began vaccination soon after exposure, delays were frequent and linked to individual characteristics. These findings highlight the need for improved pre-travel counselling, risk communication and post-exposure management. Larger multicentric studies with standardised definitions and innovative analyses are warranted to generate stronger evidence and optimise preventive strategies for rabies in international travellers.

papers.title: Bridging the Knowledge Gap on Rabies: A Cross-Sectional Study of General Practitioners’ Awareness and Clinical Management in Pakistan
papers.abstract: Objective: This study aimed to assess the knowledge regarding rabies and its management among general practitioners in Pakistan.Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted from March to December 2023 among general practitioners practicing in public and private clinics or hospitals in different cities of Pakistan. Using non-probability convenient sampling technique, a pre-tested structured questionnaires was administered among GPs to assess the knowledge and practices regarding rabies and its management. Descriptive statistics for frequency and percentage were acquired for all variables. Continuous variables are presented as mean ± SD. Independent t-test was used to compare mean knowledge and practice score and its association with demographic variables. Data was analyzed by using SPSS version 24. A P value <0.05 was considered statistically significant.Results: Out of total 500 general practitioners, 258 (51.6%) from public hospitals, and 108 (21.6%) had more than 10 years of experience. The overall mean age of the participants was 36.3 ± 7.8 years. General practitioners, (89.4%) correctly knew about the causative agent and (49.4%) about the vector of rabies. More than half of the general practitioners (53.4%) responded correctly that rabies prevention can be achieved using either cell culture vaccines or nervous tissue vaccines and (66%)had knowledge regarding anti-rabies vaccination schedule. Regarding management of dog bite wound (85.4%) had appropriate knowledge about irrigation and (27.4%) about suturing. Collectively (52%) general practitioners recognized the need to administer antibiotics along with tetanus antitoxin to patients with dog bite. Statistically no significant association was observed between knowledge and practice scores with socio-demographic characteristics.Conclusion: This study revealed that the knowledge of rabies and its management was inadequate among general practitioners of Pakistan. Frequent sessions on awareness and management of dog bite patients should be held for general practitioners to control and reduce the incidence of human rabies related deaths.
papers.journal: ANNALS OF ABBASI SHAHEED HOSPITAL AND KARACHI MEDICAL & DENTAL COLLEGE

papers.title_zh: 弥合 狂犬病 的知识差距:巴基斯坦全科医生意识和临床管理的横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Objective: This study aimed to assess the knowledge regarding rabies and its management among general practitioners in Pakistan.Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted from March to December 2023 among general practitioners practicing in public and private clinics or hospitals in different cities of Pakistan. Using non-probability convenient sampling technique, a pre-tested structured questionnaires was administered among GPs to assess the knowledge and practices regarding rabies and its management. Descriptive statistics for frequency and percentage were acquired for all variables. Continuous variables are presented as mean ± SD. Independent t-test was used to compare mean knowledge and practice score and its association with demographic variables. Data was analyzed by using SPSS version 24. A P value <0.05 was considered statistically significant.Results: Out of total 500 general practitioners, 258 (51.6%) from public hospitals, and 108 (21.6%) had more than 10 years of experience. The overall mean age of the participants was 36.3 ± 7.8 years. General practitioners, (89.4%) correctly knew about the causative agent and (49.4%) about the vector of rabies. More than half of the general practitioners (53.4%) responded correctly that rabies prevention can be achieved using either cell culture vaccines or nervous tissue vaccines and (66%)had knowledge regarding anti-rabies vaccination schedule. Regarding management of dog bite wound (85.4%) had appropriate knowledge about irrigation and (27.4%) about suturing. Collectively (52%) general practitioners recognized the need to administer antibiotics along with tetanus antitoxin to patients with dog bite. Statistically no significant association was observed between knowledge and practice scores with socio-demographic characteristics.Conclusion: This study revealed that the knowledge of rabies and its management was inadequate among general practitioners of Pakistan. Frequent sessions on awareness and management of dog bite patients should be held for general practitioners to control and reduce the incidence of human rabies related deaths.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:本研究旨在评估巴基斯坦全科医生对 狂犬病 及其管理的了解。方法:这项横断面研究于 2023 年 3 月至 12 月在巴基斯坦不同城市的公立和私人诊所或医院执业的全科医生中进行。使用非概率方便抽样技术,在全科医生中进行了预先测试的结构化调查问卷,以评估有关 狂犬病 及其管理的知识和实践。获得所有变量的频率和百分比的描述性统计数据。连续变量以平均值±标准差表示。独立 t 检验用于比较平均知识和实践得分及其与人口统计变量的关联。数据采用SPSS 24版进行分析。P值<0.05被认为有统计学意义。结果:500名全科医生中,258名(51.6%)来自公立医院,108名(21.6%)拥有10年以上经验。参与者的总体平均年龄为 36.3 ± 7.8 岁。全科医生(89.4%)正确了解病原体,(49.4%)正确了解 媒介 或 狂犬病。超过一半的全科医生 (53.4%) 正确回答,可以使用细胞培养物 疫苗 或神经组织 疫苗 来实现 狂犬病 预防,并且 (66%) 了解有关抗 狂犬病 疫苗接种 时间表的知识。关于狗咬伤伤口的处理(85.4%)有适当的冲洗知识和(27.4%)有缝合知识。总体而言(52%)全科医生认识到需要对被狗咬伤的患者使用抗生素和破伤风抗毒素。从统计上看,知识和实践得分与社会人口特征之间没有显着关联。结论:这项研究表明,巴基斯坦全科医生对 狂犬病 及其管理的了解不足。应经常为全科医生举办有关狗咬伤患者的认识和管理的会议,以控制和减少与人类 狂犬病 相关的死亡。
